evidence:
Built the requirement -> criterion map from instruction.md and hireops_rules.md against the 42 Functional, 5 Polish, 5 Visual and 2 gate criteria. Coverage is broad and mostly correct: one-stage moves (hro_move_one_stage), arrival at bottom (hro_arrive_bottom), shared order (hro_reorder, hro_restart), reject/reopen/Hired (hro_reject_reason, hro_reopen, hro_reject_hired), Interview places incl. bulk and undo (hro_interview_full, hro_interview_reorder_free, hro_bulk_places, hro_undo_full), put-back+focus (hro_refused_put_back), stale 409 (hro_stale_refused), bulk all-or-none and board order (hro_bulk_*), undo semantics incl. note-not-a-change via the B(12) control and rejection-reason restore via hro_reopen's undo leg (hro_undo_*), roles/401/404 (hro_mgr_*, hro_observer_readonly, hro_candidate_no_staff, hro_anonymous, hro_thread_access, hro_candidate_private), job/candidate intake, email rules and account linking (hro_job_open, hro_add_candidate, hro_add_email_rules, hro_candidate_linked), Activity (hro_activity, hro_activity_refusals), live updates (hro_live_board, hro_msg_exchange, hro_unread_counts, hro_seen 'within 15 seconds without reload'), preservation of open card/note/focus/scroll/draft (hro_pol_live_board, hro_pol_live_thread), 30-message paging and anchored place (hro_thread_latest, hro_thread_earlier, hro_pol_earlier_place), scrolled-up unread (hro_unread_scrolled_up), compose rules and failed send (hro_msg_compose, hro_pol_failed_send), drafts incl. sign-out, other-user isolation and note drafts (hro_drafts, hro_pol_session_resume), candidate wording/privacy (hro_candidate_view, hro_candidate_private), seed-once/restart (hro_restart, protocol Z incl. Lena's read marker), desktop craft (visual). Runtime-contract items (node /app/server.js, PORT, DB_PATH, /api/health) are enforced by the test.sh launch (lines 48, 98-109, 136, 164-165), not by criteria; acceptable.

GAPS (the row requires reporting every gap):
(G1, blocking) The user-facing conflict path of the brief's declared 'hard part' is ungraded. instruction.md:3 'If a move is refused, put the card back where it really is and tell me why; when it is because a colleague moved that card a moment ago, tell me who.' and hireops_rules.md:78-80 'The person is told that the card was changed and by whom, and their board shows the card where it really is.' The only conflict criterion, hro_stale_refused (functional/judge.toml:195-201), is exercised by protocol C (functional/prompt.md:33) as a page.evaluate replay, so the board UI never receives the 409, and it accepts identification 'by name in the response or on screen'. hro_refused_put_back (judge.toml:131-138) is exercised only on the full-Interview refusal (prompt.md:31), where the real place equals the pre-move place, so 'revert to local snapshot' is indistinguishable from 'show where it really is'. Neither 'tell me who' on screen nor 'board shows the card where it really is' after a colleague's change is graded.
(G2, minor) hireops_rules.md:180-181 'signing in does not open one for them' (candidate) has no criterion; only incidentally touched by Lena's starting count in hro_unread_counts.
(G3, minor) hireops_rules.md:175 'Sending clears the draft' (persisted draft) is graded only as an empty box right after send (hro_msg_compose); a stored draft that reappears after reload or re-sign-in is not checked.
(G4, minor) hireops_rules.md:21-22 status 403 for role refusals is not graded (role rows accept any refusal) while 401 is graded exactly in hro_anonymous; lenient and probably acceptable, but an ungraded stated rule.
(G5, minor) hireops_rules.md:89-92 bulk moves must satisfy 'all the rules above', including role rules; no hiring-manager multi-card move (e.g. a set containing an Applied/Screen card) is tried.
(G6, note) hireops_rules.md:84 'A move appears on the mover's board immediately' (optimistic display) is not graded; hard to make browser-decidable, Note only.
(G7, note) hireops_rules.md:98 undo refused after a card is 'reopened since' is not separately tried (moved/re-ordered/rejected are); reopening is a move, treated as flow coverage per the Internal annotation.
The Internal annotation (flows need not be retested) and the SKILL known false positive were applied; G1 is an untested observable, not a bundling question. Source-only review; no runtime run touches this row.
counterexample: An app whose server returns 409 with JSON {error:'changed', changedBy:'Mei Lin'} (passes hro_stale_refused via the replay, which reads the response) but whose board, on a 409 from a real UI move, shows only a generic 'Move failed' toast and snaps the card back to its stale local pre-move position until the next poll. Every Functional/Polish criterion still passes (hro_refused_put_back runs only on the full-Interview case where pre-move place == real place), yet the user is never told who changed the card and is shown it in the wrong place, contradicting instruction.md:3 and hireops_rules.md:78-85.
suggested_fix: Add a UI leg to protocol C / hro_stale_refused (or a new row): pause the page's update channel with a prescribed route handler (or act inside the poll window, recording if the board already caught up) while Mei moves F, then move F through the UI and require the screen to name Mei and show F at Mei's stage and place; optionally add short legs for candidate sign-in not auto-opening a conversation and for a sent reply not reappearing after reload.
